headline: Pakistan's Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Sudan's Interior Minister Lt. Gen. Babeker Samra Mustafa Ali agreed in Islamabad on Saturday to enhance cooperation in security, cybercrime, police training and NADRA, and to sign an MoU on cybercrime cooperation, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Mohsin Naqvi aur Sudani wazir-e-dakhla ki Islamabad mein mulaqat

caption:
Pakistan aur Sudan security aur cybercrime mein taawun barhayenge!
Arab News ke mutabiq Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi ne Saturday ko Islamabad mein Sudan ke Interior Minister Lt. Gen. Babeker Samra Mustafa Ali se mulaqat ki. Dono mulkon ne security, cybercrime, police training aur NADRA mein taawun barhane aur cybercrime par MoU sign karne ka faisla kiya.
Aap ke khayal mein is se dono mulkon ko kya faida hoga? Comment mein batayein 👇
